feature: No thin line along a turned or reshaped layer
summary: A pasted picture that is turned, reshaped or tipped now blends into what is under it. The thin grey line along its edge is gone on the canvas and in exports.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. The fix is in the shared renderer, so Current has it too. Walk: a-turned-layer-has-no-seam-walk.

try.do: Open a white picture and draw a red rectangle on it.
Drag a marquee round the rectangle with white around it, then choose Copy Merged and Paste.
Pick Skew & distort on the chip and drag two corners.
Press Escape, then drag the knob to turn the layer.
Click off the layer and zoom to 50 percent.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Compare the same view before the fix: a grey outline runs round the copy.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

evaluate: On your own picture, is the line gone at 79 percent, where you first saw it?
Does a coloured layer's turned edge still look smooth, with no lighter or darker rim?
Does a pasted screenshot sitting half a pixel off now look as clean as one on whole pixels?
rough: Measured in the real app at Next defaults, worst level off white along the outline, before then after: 25 percent 31 then 0, 50 percent 64 then 0, 79 percent 0 then 0, 100 percent 0 then 0, 200 percent 0 then 0, export 1x 64 then 0, export 2x 0 then 0. The few near-white pixels left are the red shape's own soft edge.

With the sharp zoom copy switched off the same walk read 63 at 79 percent and 46 at 100 percent before the fix, and 0 after. That switch exists only in Next and your title bar said Photonz (Dev), so you were probably on Current. That is inferred, not observed.
My line at 79 percent was 3 to 5 screen pixels wide and yours was 1 to 2, so I matched your reading but not your exact state. Please check your own picture.
The seam was wider than the report: any pasted picture whose edge fell between pixels had it, including an unturned layer half a pixel off, and a turned group. All are fixed and tested.
